name: British Events
description: New campaign events for Great Britain in the game's own event window. Each asks a random price (money, supplies, specialists or goods from the home storage): pay at once for its effect or pass. Raise how many factories/shipyards Britain can rent (Army Extraordinaries, Navy Board merchant yards, Carron carronades) or boost the home settlements' population (The Emigration Ships Are Stayed). More can be added as *.event.json files. Fired events are stored in the save.
author: UGAR modding project
